tagline: 柯达数码相机，2005 年发布
description: 柯达于2005年推出的数码相机。配备1:2.7-1:4.6/34-102mm aspheric all-glass Schneider-Kreuznach Variogon zoom lens。快门速度auto: 1/8-1/1400 sec., long time: 0.5-8 sec.。TTL autofocus, auto or center-zone。

specs.传感器: 1/2.5 inch CCD, 4:3 aspect ratio, 2832×2128 pixels (6 megapixels), sensitivity up to 400 ASA (800 emulated)
specs.镜头: 1:2.7-1:4.6/34-102mm aspheric all-glass Schneider-Kreuznach Variogon zoom lens
specs.曝光测光: TTL, multipattern or center-spot or center-weighted
specs.取景器: optical real image finder, 84% field of view
specs.重量: 150 g without rechargeable AA lithium batteries
specs.英文简介: The Kodak EasyShare C663 is a digital still camera designed in Japan for Kodak.
